more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Erythorbic acid is used as an antioxidant in food. Its technological role is to slow oxidation in food.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include non-heat-treated processed meat, heat-treated meat products, unprocessed fish, processed fish and fishery products including molluscs and crustaceans. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.daily_intake: 6 mg/kg body weight/day, combined erythorbic acid and sodium erythorbate (EFSA, 2016).
more_info.side_effects:
Assessed food-use estimates remained below the limit.
Animal body-weight effects at higher doses supported the limit; the review found no genotoxicity concern.
